scope: New, explicitly fully observed 40-state finite-horizon maintenance MDP using the frozen R15 generator. It is not the R15 hidden-content task, a neural learner, a continuous free-boundary problem, or a production neuron.
information: Every arm observes the current phase/content state, public interval, and steps remaining; all arms have the same known Q, candidate reset kernels, payoffs and RUN/RESET/STOP actions. No arm observes future random draws.
reward_contract: Discrete left-endpoint stage reward times dt. RUN then transitions by exp(dt Q). RESET first samples a registered recovery kernel, pays its full fee, receives stage reward at the reset state, then transitions by the same exp(dt Q). STOP receives current stop value and terminates. At horizon zero STOP is mandatory. These are declared synthetic task units, not energy or financial welfare.
boundary_rule: STOP when remaining <= stop_steps; otherwise RUN in recovery; otherwise RESET when phase - 2*content <= threshold, else RUN.
selection: Four distinct train/selection namespaces: kernel-only (3 candidates, top 2); recovery-only (2, both); joint reset (6, top 3); boundary with the selected joint reset (18, top 4). Train and selection tapes are independent; candidate evaluations within each stage share common random numbers. All attempts and candidate preparation/rollout costs are retained. Boundary selection does not retune reset selection.
finite_dp: Backward induction is optimal only for this fully observed finite-state, finite-action, finite-horizon registered MDP and selected reset kernel. The ordinary same-Q DP is retained with identical action capability and model; equality is expected and is not an HX-specific gain.
confirmation_freeze: Remote source/protocol commit before training; remote commit containing all selected policies and training artifacts before fresh confirmation. Confirmation must validate the complete source and training hashes from the publication receipt. No selection or threshold changes after confirmation.
statistics: Fit is the independent unit (n=8). Report paired per-fit returns, two-sided Student-t 95% intervals, and exact two-sided sign-flip p-values. Holm correction across four non-equivalence primary tests (two contrasts x two domains). Finite-profile gain requires paired mean >= 0.01 and Holm p <= 0.05. Mechanism contrasts are descriptive; no broad scientific acceptance follows.
cost: Record process CPU for common model/tape preparation, every training and selection candidate, each DP policy preparation, and all confirmation executions. Include failed attempts. Report these as measured research CPU, not energy, network, total project cost or deployment speed. Shared preparation is reported once in research total and charged in full to any independently deployed arm.
